perspective:
From SEEKER’s perspective, the available information is:

- I was greeted by RECOMMENDER with “Good evening!”
- I asked whether there were any new movies out worth watching.
- I heard RECOMMENDER ask what movie genres I’m interested in.
- I heard RECOMMENDER say they thought *Bright* (2017) was really good, even without the back story.
- I said I had never heard of *Bright*.
- I heard RECOMMENDER say they saw *Star Wars: Episode VIII – The Last Jedi* (2017) as well.
- I said I really like all kinds of movies and will watch a kids movie followed by a horror flick.
- I heard RECOMMENDER say *Bright* (2017) is a Netflix original starring Will Smith.
- I said I’m not a fan of Star Wars, said “oh yeah I did see that,” and said “may have to watch that one.”
- I heard RECOMMENDER recommend *Coco* (2017) if I like animation or kids movies.
- I said *Coco* is on my short list and I may check it out tonight.
- I heard RECOMMENDER say if I like action I might like *Wonder Woman* (2017).
- I heard RECOMMENDER say they personally will watch a horror movie then an animation/kids movie to calm their nerves.
- I said I’ve heard great things about *Wonder Woman* and agreed that horror then animation is a good way to do it.
- I heard RECOMMENDER say they watched *It* (2017) in theatres and that I might like it as well.
